finalText:
CHANGELOG.md updated, section 4.2.0 added.

Went through all 380 commits + PR sheet. Real signal buried under repeated dep bumps and templated refactors (same rename/collapse/split noise across every module). Found:

**Breaking** — auth now returns 401 not 403 for expired tokens. Client code branching on 403 will break.

**Added** — webhook retry with exponential backoff (only real feat commit in whole range).

**Fixed** — grouped by root cause, since same bug hit multiple modules separately:
- null-cursor crash in paginator (db/api/queue/webhooks, 4 separate fixes)
- empty allowlist handling (store/db/jobs, 3 fixes)
- double-trim trailing-slash bug (queue/jobs)
- HTTP hangs — timer leak on socket drop + pool not closing on shutdown
- trace ID dropped across API retries
- db client was logging full request body — worth flagging, sensitive-data exposure
- duplicate response header (core/billing/http)
- token-parse error messages tightened (core/billing/queue)
- latency histogram wrong units (core/store)

Left out: all `chore(deps)`, all `refactor`/`ci`/`test`/`docs` commits — no user-visible behavior change. Also skipped perf commits (JSON round-trip skip, clone avoidance, schema reuse) — internal hot-path tuning, no observable contract change worth a line.
